subject: Coach draft grades, game 1 (expert Garen the reviewer knows)
context: Garen: Conqueror, Doran's Blade, Nimbus Cloak, Ignite + Flash (aggressive level 1 setup). Darius: Stormraider's Surge (rune 8230), Nimbus Cloak, Bone Plating, Flash + Ignite.

notes.text: Auto-for-auto trade to pop Darius's Bone Plating without using an ability, then walked out of range before Darius got auto + W off. Lost a little health, still a good trade.
notes.rule: A short trade that pops a defensive rune (Bone Plating) before an all-in is good even when it loses on damage.

notes.text: Right idea: Darius has no Bone Plating up and runs Stormraider's instead of Conqueror, so Garen should win a straight headbutt. Darius played it well: W slow, kited the E spins, Ignite procced Nimbus Cloak to close, then Stormraider's. Garen's E mostly missed and the fight got extended.
takeaways: Garen had Nimbus Cloak too: Ignite early so he doesn't get kited out.
Starting with an auto stalls Garen and lets Darius space out of E. Walk up with E, Ignite after Darius's W.
Even then it's a stat/DPS check.

notes.text: Garen should have been aggressive: a level up even after dying and being down Long Sword + Boots, with a much bigger wave. Darius's Q at 2:24 was spaced badly (Garen got hit by it, not the handle) so Garen could walk up with E + Q for a good trade, crash the wave, maybe kill.
notes.rule: Level up + bigger wave + opponent misspaced = take the trade, even when behind on items.

notes.text: Crashing a small wave with E, hit by Darius Q, then Darius E once Garen's E was down. Forced all-in: good fighting in his own wave and kiting to top brush on cooldowns, but W used too early (no shield value), maybe a misclick 2:44-2:45 delaying an auto, possibly Flashed into the Q blade. Darius barely lived with Flash. A 1-for-1 would have been fine since Garen was crashing a big wave.
takeaways: The root cause is ~2:30: either commit to crash and recall to come back even on items, or play aggressive. Garen was in between.
Better E use wins it; better W timing at least trades 1-for-1.

notes.text: Not recalling: farming under tower. After two deaths in a hard matchup Garen is a passenger: don't die, keep farm. Could have traded back a bit, but once items and levels gap, trades that used to be fine look bad on stats alone.
notes.rule: When far behind, judge farming and survival, not trades.

notes.text: Garen looks tilted: standing still under tower, thought he was out of E range, got hit and died. A washed data point.
notes.rule: Obvious tilt or AFK misplays shouldn't teach the model.

summary: Good game to review; good Garen player.
